# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Anthony Pye is a small boy with a dark, sullen face. He has black eyes that convey expressions ranging from hostility to curiosity and mockery.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023)_

## Personality

Anthony Pye is a mischievous individual who carries himself with an impertinent swagger. He holds a clear bias against female educators, expressing the belief that they are inherently ineffective.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001)_

## Traits

## History

Anthony Pye was an orphan who was taken in by his aunt, Mrs. George Pye. After becoming a student at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school under the instruction of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), he put a mouse in her desk during a day when she was already irritable from a toothache. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) whipped him for the prank, which ultimately earned Anthony's respect.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P22](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0022), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P23](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0023), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), +111 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--anthony-pye.md)

Anthony Pye is one of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's students at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. Their relationship is initially marked by tension, culminating in an incident where Anthony places a mouse in Anne's desk and she reacts by whipping him during a difficult day. Surprisingly, this severe punishment earns [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his respect, transforming his behavior toward her.

- Student of — pupil in her schoolroom  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023)</sub>
